title: Chapter 4: Before the Next Full Moon

image.alt: Before the Next Full Moon chapter art

paragraphs: 冒險者上船後，對船隻進行了一番調查，但並未發現任何異狀。
深夜時分，喜利・歐喜利隱約聽見一個聲音低語，告訴他——有人跟著他們上船了。
於是，他獨自搜尋整艘船，最終在船艙中找到了瑪莉。瑪莉表示，既然冒險者是要去幫助米多莉，她也希望能盡一份力，因此才偷偷跟了上來。
隔天，瑪莉提醒眾人，由於娜塔莎港對正統派津菈教極為反感，他們應避免暴露與教會的關係。同時，她也提供斗篷與藥水，協助冒險者後續行動。
傍晚過後，船隻在細雨中緩緩駛入娜塔莎港。港口空無一人，整座小鎮顯得破敗而死寂。
就在眾人下船之際，一道黑影從船上竄出，迅速消失在夜色之中。
眾人面面相覷，但仍決定先前往津菈教在當地的據點——新津菈教會。該處由希娜修女負責。
冒險者刻意隱瞞來此尋找米多莉的真正目的，只表示自己是瑪莉修女的朋友。希娜修女提到，5/13晚上湯馬士・湯普森爵士將舉辦一場晚宴，鎮上居民皆會出席，這讓冒險者感到十分可疑。
他們同時推測，米多莉最有可能出現的地方，就是位於小鎮另一端山丘上的湯普森宅邸。詢問前往方式後得知，這座破敗小鎮幾乎只有一條主路，只需沿著港口的道路前行即可抵達。
於是，冒險者暫時借住在教堂，準備隔天一早在鎮上打聽消息，尋找潛入宅邸的機會。
隔天一早，冒險者來到鎮上，偶然幫助了一名名叫彼得的男子。他正忙著將大量物資搬上車。
在協助過程中，他們與彼得攀談，得知這些物資正是要送往湯普森宅邸，用於晚宴準備。
於是，冒險者找了個理由加入他的工作，打算藉此混入宅邸。
在彼得的帶領下，冒險者們來到了坐落於山丘上的湯普森宅邸。彼得指揮眾人協助晚宴的準備工作：龍恩與瑪莉留在廚房準備餐點；喜利・歐喜利與薩梅爾則一邊布置大廳，一邊暗中四處調查。然而，把守樓梯的衛兵並不允許兩人前往二樓，而他們在一樓也沒有發現任何明顯可疑之處。
另一方面，YHWH 悄悄離開宅邸，前往旁邊的一棟廢棄建築。他隱約察覺到建築內殘留著魔法的痕跡，然而四周所有出入口都已被封死。正當 YHWH 準備近一步調查時，他突然感覺到有人正從宅邸內監視著自己的一舉一動。察覺情況不對後，他立刻折返回宅邸。
回到宅邸後，YHWH 向彼得詢問那棟廢棄建築的來歷。彼得表示，那裡原本是一座舊津菈教堂，也曾是當地居民的信仰中心。過去津菈教曾爆發一場慘烈的內戰，內戰結束後，舊教堂便遭到廢棄，直到今日仍未重新啟用。後來，從方努爾市來到娜塔夏港的津菈教徒，則在靠近村莊入口處建立了新的津菈教堂。
隨著晚宴時間逐漸接近，鎮上的村民陸續來到湯普森宅邸。冒險者們也注意到，宅邸周圍不知何時已出現大量衛兵，牢牢把守住所有出入口。這些衛兵異常沉默，也不允許任何人離開晚宴會場。
待村民幾乎全數到齊後，湯普森爵士在小雪的攙扶下走入會場。冒險者們以侍者的身分穿梭其中，同時暗中觀察著兩人的狀況。他們發現湯普森爵士看起來相當虛弱，神色病懨懨的，幾乎沒有什麼精神。
晚宴開始後，湯普森爵士起身致詞。就在他說話的同時，會場地板突然亮起異樣的光芒。隨著魔法發動，在場的村民接連失去意識，就連冒險者們之中，也只有喜利・歐喜利與 YHWH 勉強保持清醒。
直到此刻，隱藏在宅邸中的真相才終於暴露。
一具巨大的骸骨魔像撞破窗戶，闖入晚宴會場，而原本守在宅邸四周、始終沉默不語的衛兵，也顯露出真面目——他們全都是由不死生物偽裝而成。
喜利・歐喜利與 YHWH 試圖抵抗，但在力量懸殊之下，很快便遭到骸骨魔像擊倒，雙雙失去了意識。
當冒險者們再次醒來時，發現自己被關在一間監牢之中。柵欄外隱約傳來某種東西來回走動的聲響，而在昏暗的牢房內，他們也看見了一個尋找已久的身影——米多莉。
看見冒險者們出現在這裡，米多莉顯得十分驚訝，連忙詢問他們為何會來到娜塔夏港。眾人向她說明，在她襲擊羅賓遜主教並離開教會後，主教便委託他們前來尋找她；除此之外，他們也必須阻止即將在娜塔夏港舉行的儀式。
冒險者們詢問米多莉目前掌握了多少情報，尤其是關於能夠阻止儀式的三顆寶石——魂之石、骨之石與血之石的下落。然而，米多莉表示自己對此並不清楚。
眾人交談之際，波看著手中替米多莉保管的聖徽，一時猶豫著是否該將它交還給她。
就在這時，牢房後方的暗門突然開啟，一道人影從陰影中走了出來。
出現在冒險者們面前的，正是小雪。
看見苦苦尋找多年的小雪，米多莉情緒激動，正想開口說些什麼，卻立刻被小雪打斷。小雪沒有多作寒暄，只要求冒險者們立刻帶著米多莉離開這裡；作為交換，她願意放走所有人。
冒險者們對她突如其來的決定感到困惑，追問她為何願意幫助眾人，但小雪並沒有解釋。
米多莉則直接問她：「那妳呢？妳會跟我們一起走嗎？」
小雪只是淡淡地搖了搖頭，要眾人不要再介入得更深。
然而，米多莉並不願意接受這個答案。她告訴小雪，如果小雪不願意離開，那麼自己也不會獨自逃走。她希望小雪能夠多依賴自己一些，因為現在的她，已經不再是當年那個無能為力的小孩子了。
眼見米多莉態度堅決，冒險者們也趁機向小雪詢問儀式的詳細情報。
在此之前，他們只從信件中得知，儀式將在 5 月 14 日零時，也就是今晚午夜舉行。距離儀式開始只剩不到三個小時，但眾人至今仍不知道三顆寶石的確切下落。
小雪沉默片刻後，拿出了自己配戴的項鍊。項鍊中央鑲嵌著一顆鮮紅色的寶石——那正是三顆寶石之一的「血之石」。
看見那條項鍊的瞬間，米多莉明顯愣了一下。它的造型，和多年前小雪留給自己的那枚銀色別針幾乎一模一樣，甚至同樣被染成了鮮紅的顏色。多年過去，小雪竟然又為自己準備了一件相同樣式的飾品。
小雪接著說明，「骨之石」則被鑲嵌在湯普森製作的巨大骸骨魔像身上。儀式開始時，湯普森必定會將那具骸骨魔像召到身邊。至於儀式的地點，則位於那座廢棄已久的舊津菈教堂。正因那裡多年無人使用，才不容易引起外人的注意。
最後，小雪告訴眾人，他們先前在聖拉雅米島取得的「大河之心」，其實正是最後一顆寶石——「魂之石」。
為了阻止儀式，小雪帶著冒險者們從牢房後方的密道逃離宅邸。
臨走之前，波終於將一直替米多莉保管的聖徽交還給她，但同時要求米多莉答應自己，無論接下來發生什麼事，都要以自身的安全為第一優先。
離開牢房後，眾人發現湯普森宅邸內早已充斥著各式各樣的不死生物。他們一路避開怪物，小心翼翼地穿過宅邸，最終來到了舊津菈教堂前。
就在冒險者們停下腳步，討論接下來該如何應付即將發生的戰鬥時——
一道鎖鏈突然從教堂內部猛然射出。
眾人甚至來不及反應，米多莉便被鎖鏈纏住，整個人瞬間被拖入了教堂之中。
冒險者們立刻衝入教堂。
破敗的教堂大廳中，地面畫滿了散發詭異光芒的魔法陣。魔法陣的三個角落分別矗立著巨大的石柱，而方才被鎖鏈拖入教堂的米多莉，此刻正被束縛在其中一根石柱上。
魔法陣中央，站著眾人不久前才見過的巨大骸骨魔像；湯普森爵士則漂浮在它身旁，等待著儀式完成。
戰鬥一開始，波便立刻衝向石柱，設法解除束縛，將米多莉救了下來。
湯普森爵士則接連施展強大的死靈法術，猛烈攻擊闖入教堂的冒險者。然而，在眾人的反擊之下，他很快便逐漸落入下風。
眼見情勢不利，湯普森爵士突然一個旋身，傳送到了魔法陣正中央。
「娜塔夏，我做的一切都是為了妳！沒有人——任何人都不能阻止我！」
話音落下，他從身上掏出一把匕首，毫不猶豫地刺向自己。
鮮血自傷口湧出，沿著地面上的魔法陣紋路迅速蔓延。隨著血液逐漸填滿整座法陣，一股濃厚的黑霧從中央升起，將湯普森爵士的身影完全吞沒。與此同時，原本站在魔法陣中央的骸骨魔像也像是被抽走了所有力量一般，轟然倒地，化為一具失去力量的遺骸。
緊接著，一道刺耳而沙啞的聲音從黑霧中傳了出來。
「湯普森……是你嗎……？」
那聲音停頓了一下。
「我好餓啊……」
黑霧逐漸散去，出現在冒險者們眼前的，已經不再是原本的湯普森爵士。
那是一張巨大而腐爛、漂浮在半空中的臉孔。一半仍殘留著湯普森爵士的樣貌，另一半則是娜塔夏扭曲的面容，兩張臉像是被強行融合在一起。它不斷發出尖銳而淒厲的哀號，同時朝著冒險者們傾瀉大量死靈法術。
眾人一邊抵擋攻擊，一邊按照《魂、骨與血》中留下的記載行動。書中提到，以儀式召喚而出的怪物，在遭到足夠程度的削弱後，可以藉由將對應的三顆寶石放置於法陣的指定位置，使整座儀式反轉，進而將召喚出的存在驅逐。
冒險者們設法從骸骨魔像的遺骸上取下「骨之石」，並將「魂之石」、「骨之石」與「血之石」分別放入三根石柱的對應位置。
三根石柱幾乎同時亮起耀眼的光芒。
光芒沿著魔法陣的紋路匯聚，最終全部集中在中央的湯普森與娜塔夏嵌合體身上。
怪物發出痛苦而淒厲的尖叫，腐爛的身軀在光芒中逐漸崩解，最後徹底消失無蹤。
教堂重新陷入寂靜。
月光穿過破裂的窗戶灑落在大廳之中。此時，滿月正好升至夜空的最高處。
冒險者們總算趕在一切無法挽回之前，成功阻止了儀式。
正當眾人以為危機終於結束時——
寂靜的教堂裡，突然響起了一聲極不合時宜的貓叫。
眾人循聲望去。
站在那裡的，竟然是墨奎斯咖啡廳裡的那隻黑貓——莫吉斯。
在眾人驚訝的目光中，黑貓莫吉斯的身形逐漸扭曲、拉長，最後化為一名年輕男子的模樣。
他看著冒險者們，緩緩開口：
「你們正在玩弄自己根本不了解的力量。我會讓你們知道，這些石頭真正的力量。」
莫吉斯伸手一揮，原本放置在三根石柱中的魂之石、骨之石與血之石同時飛起，落入了他的手中。
與此同時，一股難以言喻的強烈恐懼突然攫住眾人的心神。冒險者們彷彿失去了反抗的能力，只能眼睜睜看著莫吉斯緩步走向魔法陣中央。
接著，他突然伸手掐住米多莉的脖子。
「越深重的墮落，就能帶來越強大的力量……」
莫吉斯低聲喃喃著，準備汲取米多莉身上的力量。
然而，就在這時，一個出乎所有人意料的身影衝了上來。
小雪伸出手，一把抓住了莫吉斯。
莫吉斯轉頭看向她，臉上反而浮現出饒有興味的笑容。
「也罷，妳也可以。」
他隨即放開米多莉，將目標轉向小雪。只見莫吉斯伸手一抓，小雪便彷彿遭到某種無形力量重擊，當場倒在地上。
與此同時，三根石柱再次亮起，三道光芒同時射向位於魔法陣中央的莫吉斯。
莫吉斯卻沒有閃避。
他反而將魂之石、骨之石與血之石分別嵌入自己的身體。三顆石頭在光芒照射下逐漸散發出淡淡的光輝，彷彿正在吸收整座法陣的力量。
冒險者們立刻意識到，如果繼續放任下去，莫吉斯恐怕會將魔法陣的力量完全據為己有。
眾人強忍著恐懼奮起反擊，試圖阻止他繼續吸收力量。然而，莫吉斯展現出的實力遠超過眾人的預期。在他的猛烈攻勢下，冒險者們很快便陷入危機。
就在眾人一籌莫展之際，一道熟悉的聲音突然劃破教堂內緊張的空氣。
「聽說你們需要幫助，所以我就用最快的速度趕來了！」
下一瞬間，一名紫色長髮的巨漢猛然撞破窗戶，躍入戰場，替冒險者們擋下了莫吉斯的攻擊。
來人正是狂暴戰士幫的領袖——「鬥破蒼穹」澤克。
即使面對如此強大的敵人，澤克依然沒有顯露出絲毫懼色。他的出現也讓原本陷入劣勢的冒險者們重新燃起了勇氣。
緊接著，又有幾道人影從破裂的窗戶陸續翻入教堂。
瑪琳船長與華生也趕到了戰場，加入冒險者們一同對抗莫吉斯。
在眾人的合力攻擊下，莫吉斯終於開始受到明顯的傷害。然而，他非但沒有因此退縮，反而變得更加狂暴。每當遭受攻擊時，他體內的魔力便會猛烈爆發，向四周釋放出極為強大的衝擊，反噬所有接近他的人。
在接連不斷的魔法衝擊下，戰況迅速惡化。
沒過多久，教堂內幾乎所有人都已無力地倒在地上。
就在這時，一道低沉的聲音突然在龍恩的腦海中響起。
「使用我的力量吧。」
龍恩低頭看向自己的手臂。
那條原本用來壓制巫妖手臂力量的黃金鎖鏈，此刻早已嚴重鏽蝕。
龍恩很清楚，自己的巫妖手臂能夠吸收邪惡生物的靈魂。如果現在使用這股力量，或許便能拯救倒下的夥伴們；然而代價也十分明確——一旦再次釋放巫妖手臂的力量，這條用來封印它的黃金鎖鏈很可能會徹底崩壞。
看著倒在四周的夥伴，龍恩沒有再猶豫。
他抬起手臂，對準了莫吉斯。
下一瞬間，一股難以抑制的狂喜感湧入龍恩的意識之中。纏繞在手臂上的黃金鎖鏈也以肉眼可見的速度迅速鏽蝕、崩解。
莫吉斯臉上的神情第一次出現了動搖。
「什麼？這不可能——！」
話音未落，一股強大的力量便從龍恩的手臂中爆發而出。
莫吉斯的身體開始被拉扯、扭曲，最終連同他的力量一起被巫妖手臂徹底吞噬，消失在教堂之中。
戰鬥終於結束。
失去最後一絲力氣的眾人紛紛倒在地上休息。
然而，米多莉卻像是完全沒有察覺自己的疲憊。
她焦急地撿起掉落在地上的魂之石——大河之心，另一隻手則緊緊抱住已經失去生命跡象的小雪。
米多莉跪在舊津菈教堂的中央，低下頭，向津菈祈求。
下一瞬間，耀眼的金色光芒從她身上綻放。
光芒逐漸收束，最終全部匯聚到小雪的身上。
米多莉緊緊抱著懷中的小雪，泣不成聲。
就在此時，教堂外突然亮起無數火光。
大量火把將原本昏暗的娜塔夏港照得宛如白晝，緊接著，沉重的腳步聲從教堂外逐漸接近。
不久後，羅賓遜主教走進了教堂。
After the adventurers boarded the ship, they conducted an investigation on the ship, but found nothing unusual.
Late at night, Siri vaguely heard a voice whispering, telling him that someone was following them on the boat.
So he searched the entire ship alone and finally found Mari in the cabin. Mari said that since the adventurer was going to help Midori, she also wanted to do her part, so she followed him secretly.

The next day, Mari reminded everyone that since Port Natasha was extremely antipathetic to the orthodox Keinra sect, they should avoid revealing their ties to the church. At the same time, she also provides cloaks and potions to assist adventurers in their follow-up actions.
After dusk, the ship slowly sailed into Natasha Harbor in a drizzle. The port was deserted and the whole town looked dilapidated and lifeless.
Just as everyone was getting off the boat, a black shadow emerged from the boat and quickly disappeared into the night.
Everyone looked at each other in shock, but still decided to go to New Keinra Church, the local stronghold of the Keinra sect first. The place is in charge of Sister Hina.

The adventurer deliberately concealed the real purpose of coming here to find Midori, and only said that he was a friend of Sister Mari. Sister Hina mentioned that Syr Thompson will hold a dinner party on the evening of May 13th, and all the residents of the town will attend, which makes the adventurers feel very suspicious.

They also speculated that the most likely place for Midori was the Temple Mansion on the hill at the other end of the town. After asking how to get there, I learned that there is almost only one main road in this run-down town, and you only need to follow the road to the port to reach it.
Therefore, the adventurer temporarily stayed in the church and prepared to inquire about information in the town the next morning, looking for opportunities to sneak into the mansion.
Early the next morning, the adventurer came to the town and accidentally helped a man named Peter. He was busy loading a large amount of supplies into the car.
While assisting, they chatted with Peter and learned that these supplies were going to the Thompson Mansion for dinner preparations.
Therefore, the adventurer found a reason to join his work and planned to sneak into the mansion.

Under Peter's guidance, the adventurers arrived at Thompson Mansion atop the hill. Peter assigned everyone to help prepare for the banquet: Ron and Mari stayed in the kitchen to prepare the food, while Siri and Samael decorated the hall and secretly investigated the premises. However, the guards stationed at the staircase would not allow them onto the second floor, and they found nothing obviously suspicious on the ground floor.

Meanwhile, YHWH quietly left the mansion and headed to an abandoned building nearby. He faintly sensed traces of lingering magic within, but every entrance had been sealed. Just as YHWH was preparing to investigate further, he suddenly felt someone inside the mansion watching his every move. Realizing something was wrong, he immediately returned to the mansion.

After returning, YHWH asked Peter about the abandoned building. Peter explained that it had once been an old Keinra church and the center of worship for the local residents. A brutal civil war had broken out within the Church of Keinra years ago, and the old church was abandoned after the war ended. It had never reopened. Later, followers of Keinra who came to Natasha Harbor from Fanaur City built a new church near the village entrance.

As the banquet drew near, villagers began arriving at Thompson Mansion. The adventurers also noticed that a large number of guards had appeared around the estate, firmly securing every exit. The guards were unnaturally silent and would not allow anyone to leave the banquet hall.

Once nearly all the villagers had arrived, Syr Thompson entered the hall with Yuki supporting him. Disguised as servants, the adventurers moved among the guests while secretly observing the pair. They noticed that Syr Thompson looked extremely weak, sickly, and almost completely drained of energy.

After the banquet began, Syr Thompson rose to deliver a speech. As he spoke, an unnatural glow suddenly spread across the floor of the hall. When the magic took effect, the villagers lost consciousness one after another. Even among the adventurers, only Siri and YHWH barely managed to remain awake.
Only then was the truth hidden within the mansion finally revealed.

A massive bone golem smashed through a window and burst into the banquet hall. The guards who had stood silently around the mansion also revealed their true forms—they were all undead creatures in disguise.
Siri and YHWH tried to resist, but the difference in strength was overwhelming. The bone golem quickly struck them both down, and they lost consciousness.

When the adventurers awoke, they found themselves locked inside a cell. Beyond the bars came the faint sound of something pacing back and forth, and in the dim light they saw someone they had long been searching for—Midori.

Midori was astonished to see the adventurers there and hurriedly asked why they had come to Natasha Harbor. They explained that after she attacked Bishop Robinson and left the church, the bishop had asked them to find her. They also needed to stop the ritual that was about to take place in Natasha Harbor.

The adventurers asked how much Midori had learned, especially about the whereabouts of the three gems that could stop the ritual—the Soul Stone, the Bone Stone, and the Blood Stone. Midori, however, said that she knew nothing about them.
As they spoke, Beau looked at the holy emblem he had been keeping for Midori, hesitating over whether to return it to her.
Just then, a hidden door at the back of the cell suddenly opened, and a figure stepped out of the shadows.
The person standing before the adventurers was Yuki.

Overcome with emotion at the sight of Yuki, whom she had searched for over so many years, Midori started to speak, but Yuki immediately cut her off. Without wasting time on pleasantries, Yuki told the adventurers to take Midori and leave at once; in exchange, she would release them all.
Confused by her sudden decision, the adventurers demanded to know why she was willing to help them, but Yuki offered no explanation.
Midori asked her directly, "What about you? Are you coming with us?"
Yuki merely shook her head and told them not to involve themselves any further.

Midori refused to accept that answer. She told Yuki that if Yuki would not leave, then she would not escape alone. She wanted Yuki to rely on her more, because she was no longer the powerless child she had once been.
Seeing Midori's resolve, the adventurers took the opportunity to ask Yuki for details about the ritual.

Until then, all they knew from the letter was that the ritual would be held at midnight on May 14—midnight that very night. Less than three hours remained, yet they still did not know the exact locations of the three gems.
After a moment of silence, Yuki took out the necklace she wore. Set at its center was a brilliant red gem—one of the three gems, the Blood Stone.

The instant she saw the necklace, Midori visibly froze. Its design was almost identical to the silver brooch Yuki had left her many years ago, and it had even been dyed the same vivid red. After all these years, Yuki had made another piece of jewelry in the same style for her.

Yuki went on to explain that the Bone Stone was embedded in the massive bone golem Thompson had created. When the ritual began, Thompson would certainly summon the golem to his side. The ritual itself would take place in the long-abandoned old Keinra church. Because no one had used it for years, it was unlikely to attract outside attention.
Finally, Yuki told them that the Heart of the River they had obtained on Saint Rayami Island was in fact the last of the three gems—the Soul Stone.
To stop the ritual, Yuki led the adventurers out of the mansion through a secret passage behind the cell.
Before they left, Beau finally returned the holy emblem he had been keeping for Midori. At the same time, he made Midori promise that no matter what happened next, she would put her own safety first.

After leaving the cell, they discovered that Thompson Mansion was already overrun with all kinds of undead creatures. Avoiding the monsters, they carefully made their way through the mansion and finally reached the old Keinra church.
Just as the adventurers stopped to discuss how they should handle the coming battle—
A chain suddenly shot out from inside the church.
Before anyone could react, the chain wrapped around Midori and dragged her into the church in an instant.
The adventurers immediately charged into the church.

The floor of the ruined church hall was covered in magic circles glowing with an eerie light. Huge stone pillars stood at three corners of the formation, and Midori, who had just been dragged inside by the chain, was now bound to one of them.
At the center of the magic circle stood the massive bone golem they had seen not long before. Syr Thompson floated beside it, waiting for the ritual to be completed.
As soon as the battle began, Beau rushed toward the pillar, broke Midori's restraints, and rescued her.
Syr Thompson unleashed one powerful necromantic spell after another, savagely attacking the adventurers who had entered the church. Under their counterattack, however, he soon began to lose ground.
Realizing the battle was turning against him, Syr Thompson suddenly spun around and teleported to the exact center of the magic circle.
"Natasha, everything I have done was for you! No one—no one can stop me!"
With those words, he drew a dagger and plunged it into himself without hesitation.

Blood gushed from the wound and spread rapidly along the lines of the magic circle on the floor. As it gradually filled the entire formation, a dense black mist rose from the center and completely swallowed Syr Thompson. At the same time, the bone golem standing in the middle of the circle crashed to the ground as though all its strength had been drained away, leaving behind only powerless remains.
Then a harsh, rasping voice came from within the black mist.
"Thompson... is that you...?"
The voice paused.
"I'm so hungry..."
As the black mist slowly dispersed, the figure before the adventurers was no longer Syr Thompson as they had known him.

It was a gigantic, rotting face floating in midair. One half still bore Syr Thompson's features, while the other was Natasha's twisted visage, the two faces seemingly forced together. It released shrill, agonized wails as it poured a barrage of necromantic spells upon the adventurers.

While fending off its attacks, the adventurers followed the instructions recorded in "Soul, Bone and Blood." The book stated that once a creature summoned by the ritual had been sufficiently weakened, placing the three corresponding gems in their designated positions within the magic circle would reverse the ritual and banish the summoned entity.
The adventurers managed to remove the Bone Stone from the remains of the bone golem, then placed the Soul Stone, Bone Stone, and Blood Stone into their corresponding positions on the three pillars.
All three pillars erupted in dazzling light at almost the same moment.
The light converged along the lines of the magic circle and finally focused upon the fused form of Thompson and Natasha at its center.
The monster gave a piercing scream of agony. Its rotting body gradually disintegrated in the light until it vanished completely.
Silence returned to the church.
Moonlight streamed through the shattered windows and spilled across the hall. At that moment, the full moon reached the highest point in the night sky.
The adventurers had managed to stop the ritual before everything became irreversible.
Just as everyone thought the crisis was finally over—
A terribly ill-timed meow suddenly echoed through the silent church.
"Meow."
Everyone turned toward the sound.
Standing there was none other than Mogis, the black cat from Mogis Cafe.
Before everyone's astonished eyes, the black cat Mogis began to twist and stretch, finally taking the form of a young man.
He looked at the adventurers and slowly spoke:
"You are playing with a power you do not understand. I will show you the true power of these stones."
With a wave of Mogis's hand, the Soul Stone, Bone Stone, and Blood Stone rose simultaneously from the three pillars and flew into his grasp.

At the same time, an indescribably intense terror suddenly seized everyone. The adventurers seemed to lose all ability to resist and could only watch as Mogis slowly walked toward the center of the magic circle.
Then he suddenly reached out and seized Midori by the throat.
"The deeper the corruption, the greater the power it can yield..."
Mogis murmured under his breath as he prepared to drain Midori's power.
At that moment, however, someone no one expected rushed forward.
Yuki reached out and grabbed Mogis.
Mogis turned toward her, an intrigued smile appearing on his face instead.
"Very well. You will do too."
He immediately released Midori and turned his attention to Yuki. Mogis made a grasping motion, and Yuki was struck by some invisible force and collapsed on the spot.
At the same time, the three pillars lit up once more, sending three beams of light toward Mogis at the center of the magic circle.
Mogis did not try to evade them.

Instead, he embedded the Soul Stone, Bone Stone, and Blood Stone into his own body. Bathed in the beams, the three stones began to emit a faint glow, as though absorbing the power of the entire magic circle.
The adventurers immediately realized that if they allowed this to continue, Mogis would likely claim all of the magic circle's power for himself.

Fighting through their fear, they launched a counterattack and tried to stop him from absorbing any more power. Mogis, however, was far stronger than they had anticipated, and his ferocious assault quickly placed the adventurers in grave danger.
Just when they were at a loss, a familiar voice suddenly cut through the tension in the church.
"I heard you needed help, so I came as fast as I could!"
The next instant, a huge man with long purple hair smashed through a window and leaped into the fray, shielding the adventurers from Mogis's attack.
It was Zek, leader of the Berserker Gang, known by his fighting name, "Fighting to Break the Sky."
Even before such a powerful enemy, Zek showed not the slightest trace of fear. His arrival rekindled the courage of the adventurers, who until then had been losing ground.
Several more figures then climbed through the shattered window and entered the church.
Captain Marin and Watson had also arrived, joining the adventurers in the fight against Mogis.

Under their combined assault, Mogis finally began to suffer visible injuries. Yet rather than retreating, he only became more violent. Every time he was struck, the magic within him erupted, releasing an immensely powerful shock wave that lashed back at everyone who came near.
Under the unrelenting magical shock waves, the battle rapidly deteriorated.
Before long, nearly everyone in the church lay helpless on the ground.
At that moment, a deep voice suddenly sounded in Ron's mind.
"Use my power."
Ron looked down at his arm.
The golden chain that had once restrained the power of his lich arm was now severely corroded.

Ron knew very well that his lich arm could absorb the souls of evil creatures. Using that power now might save his fallen companions, but the price was equally clear: if he unleashed the lich arm again, the golden chain sealing it would likely break apart completely.
Looking at his fallen companions all around him, Ron hesitated no longer.
He raised his arm and aimed it at Mogis.
In the next instant, an uncontrollable surge of ecstasy flooded Ron's mind. The golden chain wrapped around his arm rapidly rusted and crumbled before his eyes.
For the first time, Mogis looked shaken.
"What? That's impossible—!"
Before he could finish, tremendous power erupted from Ron's arm.
Mogis's body began to stretch and twist until the lich arm devoured him completely, power and all, and he vanished from the church.
The battle was finally over.
With not a trace of strength left, everyone collapsed to the ground to rest.
Midori, however, seemed entirely unaware of her own exhaustion.
She hurriedly picked up the Soul Stone—the Heart of the River—from the floor, while cradling the lifeless Yuki tightly with her other arm.
Kneeling at the center of the old Keinra church, Midori bowed her head and prayed to Keinra.
In the next instant, dazzling golden light burst from her body.
The light gradually drew together until it all converged upon Yuki.
Midori held Yuki tightly in her arms, sobbing uncontrollably.
At that moment, countless lights suddenly flared outside the church.
A multitude of torches illuminated the once-dark Natasha Harbor as brightly as day, and then the sound of heavy footsteps began to approach from outside the church.
Soon afterward, Bishop Robinson entered the church.
